source: 0.5 Rogue Ops hideout. Level 1 build costs come from two community guides (grayzonewarfaregame.wiki hideout guide, GamesHorizon); four Workshop stations were also checked on the in-game build screen on 23 Oct 2026 (game 0.5.0.1) and are marked seen. Room purposes and the stim and tag change come from the official 0.5 devlogs. Codes, 0.5 sites and safes: AllThings.How, TPose Gaming, the Fandom wiki item pages, and pins from the live GZW Tac Map (fetched 25 Oct 2026). Bag sizes and weights are the wiki's item infoboxes; safes and COPs near each run are worked out from tac-map pins.

unlock.text: The hideout opens at Lab Rat rank 2 and Artisan rank 2. Smuggling contracts need Banshee rank 3.

rooms.d: Power for everything else. Most powered stations draw about 1 kW; the level 1 generator gives 9 kW and level 2 gives 18 kW.
Turns raw chemicals into medical items, stims and contraband. Capabilities: Heat Control, Extraction & Reaction, Filtration & Processing, Analysis & Precision, Storage, Safety.
Strips electronics for parts and builds tracking tags and a three-tier hacking tool. Capabilities: Compute, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Sensor & RF Processing, Storage.

order.w: Nothing that needs power runs without it. Steel, Mechanical Parts, Motor Oil and a Dynamo, all industrial loot.
Wood plus Mechanical Parts. The Workshop will not run Disassembly until a storage station exists (the game says so on the Disassembly tab), and disassembly is how junk electronics become parts.

order.a: Open Fire Pit, Plastic Drums, then the Oil Tank
order.w: The Lab's basic chemistry chain. The Oil Tank needs the Fire Pit's Heat Control first.

order.a: Basic Electronics Bench and Scavenged PC Rig
order.w: Electronics and Compute, which the Workshop's crafting builds on.
Analysis & Precision gates the finer lab work, and the PH Meter needs the Glass Set's +1 first.

order.a: Queue disassembly before you log off
order.w: Players report about 12 hours per dismantled item.

farm.d: Rectangular wooden crates painted blue. They hold the build materials.

farm.t: Tiger Bay, the Cement Factory, depots
farm.d: Steel, Mechanical Parts, Plumbing Parts, Motor Oil, Dynamo: the generator list.

farm.t: Construction site east of Crimson Shield, Military Warehouse
farm.d: Named build-material farms, around map grid 150,168 and 137,151.
Wood and Construction Material. Wood at the Sawmill is an explicit 0.5 spawn.
Circuit Boards, RAM, software and Power Supplies, most of the PC Rig.
Chemicals, glassware and medical supplies for the Lab.

farm.t: Fort Narith, YBL-1, Hunter's Paradise, the airfield

fast.d: Acetic anhydride, chloroform, ether, ethanol, HCl, EDTA, saline, sodium carbonate, aniline and lab flasks are Lab inputs. Do not sell them for cash.

fast.t: Choose morphine or heroin on purpose
fast.d: Morphine is the Lab Rat path. Heroin pays more and earns Vulture rep, but costs Lab Rat rep and puts Banshee against you.

fast.t: Give split rewards to the slow vendors
fast.d: When a task lets you pick, take Artisan, Banshee, Turncoat or Lab Rat. Gunny and Handshake have more than enough tasks to max on their own.
Vices to Gunny, jewellery to Turncoat, electronics to Lab Rat, cards and passports to Artisan. Vulture only takes valuables at about 60%, so sell to him only to farm his rank.
No vendor sells them in 0.5. Until the Lab is producing, every stim you find is worth keeping.
A spare plate carrier and a second rifle are what put full-kit raids at 60 kg. Armour can be bought; hideout parts cannot.

unv.c: Recipes for stims, tracking tags, morphine, heroin and the hacking tool
unv.r: No guide has published ingredients or times. Open each station's Production and Crafting lists in game.
Not published; only level 1 is listed.
Confirmed to exist; no coordinates published.
The community wiki says Lab Rat R2 and Artisan R2; another guide lists Lab Rat R2 only. This page uses the stricter rule.

runs.t: Tiger Bay industrial: Cement Factory and Trade Depot
runs.why: The industrial run for Steel, Mechanical Parts, Plumbing Parts and Motor Oil. Both guides name the Cement Factory.

stops.what: Named farm spot. The storage room key spawns inside it.
Industrial depot, the building type the wiki gives for the generator list. Locked door.
Offices: PC parts and software by the wiki's building types.

runs.risk: Tier 3, the biggest city, Rebels and LAF both. Bring full kit, not a pistol.

runs.t: Hunter's Paradise motel for a Dynamo
runs.why: Three named Dynamo spots inside one compound.

stops.what: East side of the motel garage among the maintenance gear, and the pickup beds around the motel.

stops.n: Shack between the living quarters and the range
stops.what: Dynamo on the bench inside.

runs.risk: Tier 2. The range has a boss task (One Shot, One Kill), so expect a commander at the firing lanes.

runs.t: Southern builder loop: Ban Langphou, Construction Site, Nony Village
runs.why: The tightest cluster of named crates on the map, close to the CSI start, with tier 2 AI. Plastics, Wood, a Dynamo and the blue crates in one loop.

stops.what: Blue-striped crate inside the house: Plastics.

stops.n: Construction Site east of Crimson Shield
stops.what: Blue-striped Building Material Crates. GamesHorizon's first-named farm spot.
Dynamo on a wooden pallet beside the concrete barriers and caged water totes.
Crate with two piles of Wood.

runs.t: Pha Lang Airfield edge: Small Marketplace
runs.why: Wood under a stilt house, and the hangars for a Dynamo.

stops.n: Small Marketplace south of Midnight Sapphire
stops.what: Wood on the dirt under the small green stilt house next to the parked pickup.
Dynamo in the wide hangars.

runs.risk: Golf 1 is a Midnight Sapphire LZ (tier 3) but the marketplace is outside the estate.

runs.t: Fort Narith west: Old Hut and Nakasa village
runs.why: Short hop off Delta 4 for Wood and Plastics without entering the fort.

stops.n: Old Hut, just north of LZ Delta 4
stops.what: Wooden supplies crate under the front overhang: 2 Wood. One more Wood on the ground by the cut timber at the back.
Fenced storage yard with lumber and shipping boxes; the blue-striped crate among the wooden crates: Plastics.

runs.risk: Delta 3 and 4 are Fort Narith LZs, so LAF patrols reach them.

runs.why: Wood at the Sawmill, Sawmill Offices for electronics, then north to the Military Warehouse, GamesHorizon's second farm spot.

stops.what: Wood is a confirmed Sawmill spawn.
Offices are where the wiki puts circuit boards, RAM, software and power supplies. The office key spawns here too.
Named build-material farm. Another guide also lists a Dynamo at a military warehouse north of Delta 4.

runs.t: Dynamo and Wood: Fort Narith fuel yard to Thavieng Farm
runs.why: A Dynamo on a bench, a Building Material Crate next to it, then Wood on the way out, and the extract is beside the farm.

stops.what: Dynamo on the wooden workbench next to the blue plastic bins, southeast side of the airfield.

stops.n: Shack past the Airfield Old Entrance
stops.what: Building Material Crate. One player found four Glass in it; contents vary.
Building Material Crate against the metal fence behind the house: 2 Wood.

runs.risk: Fort Narith is tier 3 and LAF-held. The fuel yard is on the edge, so go in from Delta 1 and do not push into the base.

runs.t: Lab inputs: Kiu Vongsa Doctor's Office
runs.why: Clinics are where the wiki puts chemicals and glassware, and this one is a tier 1 town next to the CSI start.

stops.what: Clinic. Its key spawns at the same spot.

runs.risk: Tier 1. Also try Pha Lang's and Nam Thaven's doctor's offices, and the UNLRA lab in Tiger Bay.

runs.why: Dynamos inside, and military software, which the wiki puts at military sites.

stops.what: Dynamo at the entrance and in the technical spaces, the air room and the storage shelves on the bunker floors.

stops.n: Supply outbuilding by the vehicle dump
stops.what: Dynamo, on the way into YBL West.
Military sites are where the wiki puts Military Software.

runs.risk: Underground, LLA-held, close quarters. Light kit is fine; you will not be carrying much out.

runs.t: Hacking tool raid 1: Northern Reach to the LAF-Occupied Villa
runs.why: Two of the three tier 3 hacking-tool parts in one raid: the Jammer, then the Satcom.

stops.n: Northern Reach Offices (B1/B2), centre of the base
stops.what: Yellow sticky note on a desk with the Armory code, 9091.

stops.n: Northern Reach Armory, just south of the Offices
stops.what: Opens with 9091. Optional loot; leave bag space.
Door Console Repair Report beside the green laptop gives the Comms Room code (8907). The Jammer is on the table inside.
Portable Satcom Terminal outside the locked Commander's Office.

runs.risk: Tier 4, and Ground Zero lies between the two sites. Hurt or heavy after the Jammer: extract at Hotel 4 and do the Villa on its own.

runs.t: Hacking tool raid 2: RLSL-1 for the Radar Signal Processor
runs.why: The third part. Do it as its own raid.

stops.what: Radar Signal Processor pin.
Second Radar Signal Processor pin, if the first is gone.

runs.risk: Tier 4. Tango 2 is the other way out.

unplotted.d: A Building Material Crate in the yard and another by the base offices (player report), and a Dynamo on the blue workbench in the maintenance building and in the crate by the green containers (TPose). Not on our map yet.
Dynamo in the upper-floor supply closets of the main hotel.

sites.how: TPose gives 169, 151-152 for the unmarked building between the Research Facility and the HQ. Not pinned on any map yet.
sites.lzNote: the closest LZ on the live tac map. One walkthrough says Lima 1, which is at YBL-1, 30 squares away, so treat that as wrong.

codes.door: Comms Room (server room) keypad, HQ upper floor
codes.note: Door Console Repair Report, beside the green laptop on the desk in the upper-floor catwalk office opposite the Comms Room door. TPose instead puts the note in a ground-floor room near the HQ entrance; check both.
Yellow sticky note on a desk in the B1/B2 container offices (the two-storey modular offices).

sites.also: Counter-IED/Jammer Unit on the central table inside the Comms Room, and a second one in the unmarked building at 169,151. Radio tower: hack the second-floor terminal (At Doom's Gate).
layout: north end. The yard is the first At Doom's Gate objective.
centre of the base, south of the Supply Yard. The 9091 armory note is here.
east of the Offices. The barracks diary is in Accommodations.
west of the Offices, the big building. Go upstairs for the 8907 note and the Comms Room.
just south of the Offices. Opens with 9091.
south end, on the red Ground Zero line.
an LZ marker labelled HO sits off the east edge; Hotel 4 is the closest LZ on the tac map.

sites.how: Two Radar Signal Processor pins on the live tac map, at 151.5,140.6 and 150.3,139.8. The wiki puts that item in the RLSL-1 HQ server room.
sites.lzNote: new 0.5 LZ, closest to the processor pins; Tango 2 is the other side.
sites.also: Radar Signal Processor: HQ first-floor comms rooms and the garage northeast of the telescope building.

sites.how: Pinned on the live tac map, with a Portable Satcom Terminal pin at 181.8,142.4.
sites.lzNote: new 0.5 LZ; Sierra 2 is the same distance to the south.
sites.also: Portable Satcom Terminal on the second floor, outside the locked Commander's Office.

sites.how: No map, wiki or guide has published where it is yet.

codes.note: Not published where the note is. From the 0.5.0.0 preview build, so it may have rotated.

codes.door: Second keypad, toward the experimentation ward
codes.note: Same: preview build, note location not published.
Same: preview build, note location not published.

sites.also: Portable Satcom Terminal on the central table in the main building's second-floor conference room.

hack.note: Tier 3 opens every keypad door in about 10 seconds. Each part comes from dismantling an item in the Workshop (12 hours each, per the wiki).

parts.where: RLSL-1 HQ comms/server rooms; garage northeast of the telescope building
LAF-Occupied Villa second floor outside the Commander's Office; Lakevale Sanctuary second-floor conference room
Northern Reach HQ Comms Room (code 8907); unmarked building at 169,151

safesNote: Safe positions from the live tac map. Codes rotate and the map does not list them; each safe's code is on a note in the same place, so read the note in game. None of the new 0.5 sites has a published safe yet.

light.d: These runs are about bag space, so wear enough armour to walk away from a bad contact and bring the biggest pack you own.
light.src: Armour classes and vendor ranks from each item's wiki page. The class floor per tier is this guide's advice, not a game rule.

A.d: Tier 3 runs on this page go into LAF-held bases and the biggest city. Step up a class, and carry a round the ammo chart rates through III+.
A.src: Armour classes and vendor ranks from each item's wiki page. The class floor per tier is this guide's advice, not a game rule.

best.d: Nobody has published what tier 4 AI carry, so plan for more than tier 3: the best armour you can get, and go in with an empty pack.
best.src: Armour classes and vendor ranks from each item's wiki page. The class floor per tier is this guide's advice, not a game rule.

kitsNote: COPs are not safe. In 0.5 the largest outposts can no longer be captured and became ordinary world locations, and the rest were moved around the island (official devlog). On 26 Oct 2026 a player was killed by an AI team at Outpost Mystic (133,154), which had not been activated. The COP line on each run is only the nearest outpost pin on the tac map, so clear it like any other building.

goals.d: Tiger Bay industrial is the only run with Steel, Mechanical Parts and Motor Oil. Pick up the Dynamo on a tier 2 run (Hunter's Paradise or the Southern loop) and skip Fort Narith.
Unlocks Disassembly. Wood from the Southern loop or Fort Narith west; bring a second set of Mechanical Parts home from Tiger Bay.
Plastics and Wood on the tier 2 loops, Steel from Tiger Bay, glassware from clinics.
Offices and server rooms for the PC parts, military sites for Military Software. These runs go by building type, not pinned spawns.
Three items to dismantle in the Workshop, 12 hours each. Needs the Salvaged Wooden Crate built first.
